Container.Name: wyoming-chatterbox
Container.Overview:
Wyoming protocol server for Chatterbox TTS with voice cloning. Clone any voice from a 10-30 second WAV sample and use it as a TTS provider in Home Assistant (Settings, Devices and Services, Add Integration, Wyoming Protocol, host = Unraid IP, port = 10800).
Requires an NVIDIA GPU with 4GB+ VRAM and the Nvidia-Driver plugin. First start downloads about 3.5GB of model weights into the cache path.
Put your reference WAV in the voice path as reference.wav (or change --voice-ref in Post Arguments).
To use less VRAM, add to Post Arguments: --dtype bfloat16 and --s3gen-dtype bfloat16 (half precision), and/or --model turbo or --model nano (smaller, faster models). The first start of a new model downloads 3-4GB with no progress shown in the log.
Container.Requires: NVIDIA GPU (4GB+ VRAM) and the Nvidia-Driver plugin.

Config.Name: Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Wyoming protocol port. Point the Home Assistant Wyoming integration here.

Config.Name: Voice Reference
Config.Description: Folder holding your voice reference WAV (10-30s of clean speech). Filename must match --voice-ref in Post Arguments.

Config.Name: Model Cache
Config.Description: HuggingFace model cache (about 3.5GB, downloaded on first start).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU to use: 'all' or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: NVIDIA driver capabilities exposed to the container.

Config.Name: PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF
Config.Description: PyTorch CUDA allocator setting (reduces VRAM fragmentation).
